basic_info.description:
Welcome to 500 Shields Street, an exceptional residence in the desirable Merced Heights neighborhood of San Francisco. This three-bedroom, one-bath home perfectly balances elegance and comfort while offering breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean and Marin Headlands.

Situated on a sunlit corner lot across from Brooks Park, this property enjoys an abundance of natural light. The inviting living room is both bright and spacious, while the eat-in kitchen features modern stainless steel appliances, ideal for culinary enthusiasts.

The lower level provides a versatile bonus space suitable for an additional bedroom or home office, complemented by a one-car garage and ample storage solutions. Outside, the private backyard awaits your visionwhether for gardening, hosting gatherings, or quiet relaxation.

500 Shields Street is a rare opportunity to own a home with stunning views and limitless potential. This property is a distinguished choice for those seeking a blend of tranquility and convenience in the heart of the city.
